main_text.p: opera in hac vita sint imperfecta, atque peccatis inquinat{a}.Ief.64.6.

p.i: Quomodo bona opera nostra nihil promerentur, cum Deus & in praesenti & in futura vita mercedem pro his se daturum promittat?

main_text.p: Merces ea no datur ex merito, sed ex gratia{b}.Lu.17.10.

p.i: An autem hac doctrina non reddit homines se-curos & prophanos?

main_text.p: Non: neque enim fieri potest, quin ii qui Christo per fidem insiti sunt, fructus proferant gratitudinis{c}.Mat.7.18. Ioan.15.5.
main_text.head: DE SACRAMENTIS.

p.i: Quoniam igitur sola fides nos Christi atque omnium beneficiorum participes facit: Unde proficiscitur?

main_text.p: A Spiritu sancto¹, qui eam per praedicationem EuangeliiEph.2.8. &6.23. Ioan.3.5. Phil.1.29. in nostris cordibus accendit, & per usum sacramentorum confirmat{e}.Mat.28.10.20. 1.Pet.1.22. 23.

Sunt sacra, & in oculos incurrentia signa, ac sigilla, ob eam causam a Deo instituta, ut per ea nobis promissionem Euangelii magis declaret & obsignet, quod scilicet, non universis tantum, verum etiam singulis credentibus, propter unicum illud Christi sacrificium in cruce pera-[?] & im[?], gratis donet remissionem peccatorum, & vitam æternam{f}.Gen.17. 11.Ro 1.11 Deu.32.6. Leuit.6.25. Hebr.8.9.[?] 4.Ezec.20.11.[?] 1.Sam.17. 36.Ief.6.6. 9.&54.9.

p.i: Non utraque igitur, & Verbum & Sacramen-ta eo spectant, ut fidem nostram ac sacrificium

page.notes: Catchword "Christi." is printed at the lower right, below the last full line, so it is kept out of the text. The superscript 1 after "sancto" has no matching footnote on this page. Line "pera-" / "& im," is hard to read at the line break: the word is marked [?] twice. Marginal references "Hebr.8.9." and "4.Ezec.20.11." are uncertain. Letter marks in the margin are read as d, e, f; the mark "e" may look like "c" in print. Left-margin references are placed beside their marks in the text, not in the order they are printed. Faint specks and smudges at the bottom of the page are not printed text and are left out.
